title: Freeze when using screen ruler
summary: Screen Ruler freezes or crashes when repeatedly switching spacing modes on multiple monitors.

judgment.rationale: The report gives an actionable scenario and supplied diagnostics, but the current failing boundary has not been established.
evidence: The original 0.76–0.78 report describes entering spacing, clicking the screen and selecting spacing again on multiple monitors; one monitor reportedly works.
Several users confirmed similar behavior through 0.86.0; the thread includes a bug report and video.
Inspected src/modules/MeasureTool/MeasureToolUI/MeasureToolXAML/MainWindow.xaml.cs: selecting tools resets core state and starts a measurement; this does not establish a failure.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce on a current build and identify the first failing stage before choosing a targeted correction.

fix_assessment.rationale: A targeted lifecycle correction may be applicable after the current failure is confirmed.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate repeated Screen Ruler spacing activation
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Measurement state reset, monitor capture or overlay lifecycle could fail on repeated activation; the exact path is unknown.
plan: Reproduce the exact multi-monitor sequence and compare a single-monitor control.
Trace state reset, overlay teardown and monitor capture to locate the first failing stage.
Correct the demonstrated lifecycle failure while preserving mode switching.
Add regression coverage for repeated spacing activation and multi-monitor transitions.
verification: Repeated spacing measurements and mode switches remain responsive on one and multiple monitors.
Closing and reopening Screen Ruler leaves no stale overlays.

confidence.rationale: The reported scenario is concrete but the current-build behavior and failing stage remain unknown.

reproduce.title: Investigate repeated Screen Ruler spacing activation
reproduce.version_requirement: Use the current PowerToys release and compare the reported version if practical.
prerequisites: Use a Windows test machine and preserve the original configuration.
setup: Use two extended monitors and enable Screen Ruler; preserve a single-monitor control configuration.
steps: 1. Activate Screen Ruler with Win+Shift+M and select spacing.
2. Click the screen to complete a measurement, then select spacing again.
3. Repeat several times and compare horizontal and vertical spacing switches.
4. Repeat with one monitor; if a freeze occurs, isolate the failed reset, capture or overlay stage in a maintainer diagnostic session.
reproduce.expected_result: The ruler remains responsive for repeated measurements and switches on both configurations.
